# Historical Jusélius Coauthorship Pipeline (Filtered Mode)

*Note: This file is preserved for historical reference and provenance from the original `Juselius_secretdoor` repository.*

## 1. Load Data & Filter to Target Cohort
```{r filter_edges, eval=FALSE}
# Keep only edges where both Author 1 and Author 2 belong to the funded cohort
edges_filtered <- all_edges %>%
  filter(from %in% target_authors$openalex_id & to %in% target_authors$openalex_id)
```

## 2. Graph Construction & Community Detection
```{r community, eval=FALSE}
g_cohort <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_filtered, directed = FALSE, vertices = target_authors)
cl <- cluster_louvain(g_cohort, weights = E(g_cohort)$weight)
V(g_cohort)$community <- cl$membership
```

## 3. Top Researchers per Community & Visualisation
```{r top3, eval=FALSE}
# Identify top 3 researchers per community by degree / weighted degree
top3 <- node_metrics %>%
  group_by(community) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = degree, n = 3)

write.csv(top3, "legacy_outputs/top3_per_community.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
